name: Falak Ameesh Patel
tagline: Medical device design: assistive and diagnostic hardware.
bio: Pharmacist and medical device engineer (M.Tech, IIT Hyderabad). I move ideas from the lab bench to working prototypes, and I build privacy-first health tech.

rows.title: padachar
rows.text: Offline step and food tracker for Android. No internet, no ads, no account.

rows.title: anukalpa
rows.text: Find the generic behind a medicine brand: 160,000+ medicines from India, the US, Canada and the EU.

rows.title: Device Class Finder
rows.text: Find a medical device's likely risk class (A to D) under India's Medical Device Rules, 2017.

rows.title: ink-health-watch
rows.text: Open-source e-paper health watch on the ESP32-S3.

rows.text: My website, with the parts in 3D.
